question: Given only the RNA profile of a cell, can the ATAC profile measured in that same cell be found again among the ATAC profiles of many candidate cells?
analysis_unit: Individual cell (single nucleus with co-measured RNA and ATAC in development splits)
estimand: Out-of-sample Mean Reciprocal Rank of a cell's true paired ATAC profile among unseen candidate ATAC profiles from the same donor, conditioned solely on that cell's measured RNA profile.
target: Cell-level pairing identity and rank of each unseen query cell's true co-measured ATAC profile within the candidate ATAC pool.
allowed_inputs: Paired RNA UMI counts and ATAC peak counts from development cells, partitioned by cell into disjoint training and evaluation splits
Ground-truth cell pairing indices on training splits for model fitting and on evaluation splits strictly for scoring retrieval
Peak-to-gene annotations (TSS distances and promoter/distal flags) and gene start coordinates
Unseen ATAC-only held-out cells of the same donor solely as optional additional distractors in the candidate ATAC pool
Development-set WNN cell-type annotations solely for post-hoc stratified reporting by population, never for training, selection, or retrieval
forbidden_inputs: Joint WNN cell-type annotations as model inputs or evaluation truth
Query cell ATAC profiles or test-split pairing labels during inference
Other query cells' RNA profiles or test-batch one-to-one assignment constraints
Evaluation RNA or ATAC profiles smoothed or imputed across cells
Evaluation-split cells during feature selection, latent space fitting, or hyperparameter tuning
Candidate cells' held-out or paired RNA profiles during candidate scoring

forbidden_reasons.Joint WNN cell-type annotations as model: Constructed from joint RNA-ATAC clustering; using them as inputs leaks cross-modal pairing, and matching cell type does not prove same-cell retrieval.
forbidden_reasons.Query cell ATAC profiles or test-split p: Directly leaks the ground-truth paired ATAC identity that must be recovered solely from the query cell's RNA profile.
forbidden_reasons.Other query cells' RNA profiles or test-: The question conditions on one cell's RNA profile alone; bipartite matching across queries exploits mutual exclusion rather than single-cell retrieval.
forbidden_reasons.Evaluation RNA or ATAC profiles smoothed: Cross-cell smoothing leaks graph neighborhood structure across test cells and masks single-cell dropout noise, overstating individual-cell retrieval accuracy.
forbidden_reasons.Evaluation-split cells during feature se: Fitting preprocessing, embeddings, or hyperparameters on evaluation cells leaks test-set structure and biases out-of-sample retrieval estimates upward.
forbidden_reasons.Candidate cells' held-out or paired RNA: Candidates represent ATAC profiles only; accessing candidate RNA reduces cross-modal retrieval to unimodal RNA-to-RNA matching.

required_comparators: Floor 0 (permutation null): uniform random ranking of unseen candidate ATAC profiles
Floor 1 (sequencing depth): ranking candidate ATAC profiles by log total fragment depth matched to query log RNA UMI depth
Floor 2 (unlearned gene activity): similarity between query log-RNA and candidate ATAC promoter-plus-proximal peak sums from peak-gene links
Floor 3 (coarse cell-type cluster): matching query RNA to candidate ATAC via training-fitted cluster centroids (baseline k=20)
Simple linear reference: ridge, PLS, or CCA alignment between training-fitted RNA and ATAC latent spaces
Noise-ceiling ruler (upper bound): unimodal split-half count self-retrieval via binomial thinning on evaluation cells
primary_metric: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of the true paired ATAC profile across unseen query cells, using deterministic mid-ranks for ties
secondary_metrics: Exact top-1 retrieval rate (Recall@1) across unseen query cells
1 - FOSCTTM (mean fraction of non-matching candidate ATAC profiles ranked strictly farther than the true paired profile)
Within-population and macro-averaged MRR and Recall@1 across cell types to evaluate rare populations and sub-cluster resolution
Ratio of cross-modal retrieval MRR to the binomial-thinning unimodal split-half self-retrieval noise ceiling on the same query cells

acceptance_criteria.statement: Retrieval uses only a single query cell's RNA profile and candidate ATAC profiles, without WNN annotations or cross-query bijection constraints.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Zero forbidden inputs used in fitting, tuning, or inference; each query RNA profile is scored independently against the candidate pool.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each cell and both its RNA and ATAC profiles stay strictly on one side of every train, validation, and test split.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Cell-identifier overlap between training sets and evaluation query or candidate sets must equal zero across all splits.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Feature selection, normalisation scalers, latent representations, and hyperparameters are selected strictly within inner training splits.
acceptance_criteria.rule: All data-dependent preprocessing and hyperparameter choices are frozen from inner development splits before touching held-out evaluation cells.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Retrieval is scored on measured, unsmoothed single-cell query RNA and unsmoothed candidate ATAC profiles unseen during training.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Evaluation profiles undergo only per-cell transformations or training-fitted projections, with no cross-cell smoothing or imputation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All models and comparators are evaluated on identical unseen query cells against the exact same candidate ATAC pool.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Query cell IDs, candidate pool membership and size, and mid-rank tie handling are identical across every compared arm.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Claims of individual or sub-cluster retrieval require MRR significantly above permutation, sequencing-depth, gene-activity, and coarse cluster floors.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Lower bound of the paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for MRR difference (method minus each floor) exceeds zero.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Nonlinear or complex retrieval architectures are benchmarked directly against a simple linear latent alignment on identical evaluation units.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Complex methods are favoured over the linear reference only when the paired-bootstrap 95% CI for MRR gain excludes zero.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Primary MRR estimates and comparator differences include 95% confidence intervals; population-specific claims control false discovery rate at 5%.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Paired nonparametric bootstrap over unseen query cells at 95% confidence; Benjamini-Hochberg at 5% FDR across cell populations if stratified claims are made.

conclusion_options: Yes, at single-cell resolution: retrieval frequently ranks the true paired ATAC profile first and significantly beats coarse cluster, gene-activity, and depth floors, approaching the unimodal split-half noise ceiling.

Partially (sub-cluster neighborhood only): retrieval significantly beats coarse cluster, gene-activity, and depth floors, but single-cell measurement sparsity prevents reliable top-1 recovery of the exact paired ATAC profile.

Cell-type resolution only: retrieval significantly beats random and sequencing-depth floors, but does not significantly exceed coarse cluster-level matching; individual cells within a cell type cannot be distinguished.
No biological retrieval: given only a cell's RNA profile, ranking candidate ATAC profiles does not significantly outperform random permutation or technical sequencing-depth matching on unseen cells.
conclusion_scope: Applies to unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs from this single healthy donor at this sequencing depth and candidate-pool size; establishes nothing about other donors, tissues, granulocytes, or disease states.
notes: Provider text describes ATAC-to-RNA prediction, whereas this question requires RNA-to-ATAC cell retrieval on nested splits of the 7,288 paired development cells because the 3,124 held-out cells lack RNA.
